entry.title: 不抽样的格点场论：用分部积分精确计算 / Lattice field theory without sampling

link.title: 不抽样的格点场论：用分部积分精确计算 / Lattice field theory without sampling

entry.content:
格点 Monte Carlo 在临界减慢、拓扑冻结和符号问题面前会失灵。本文介绍一条不抽样的路线：用分部积分把格点积分化成有限个主积分，再解它们关于跳跃参数的微分方程，在小格子上得到任意精度的精确结果，并用它检验复 Langevin 等采样方法。

阅读全文

Lattice Monte Carlo struggles with critical slowing down, topological freezing and the sign problem. This post describes a route without sampling: integration-by-parts relations reduce lattice integrals to a finite set of master integrals, whose differential equations in the hopping parameter give exact results to arbitrary precision on small lattices, used here to test complex Langevin and other samplers. (Text in Chinese.)

Read the full post
entry.summary: 分部积分、主积分与微分方程：有限密度、实时间和 SU(3) 重夸克有效理论的精确结果。Integration by parts, master integrals and differential equations for exact lattice results.

entry.title: SPS: 随机路径采样器 / Stochastic Path Sampler

link.title: SPS: 随机路径采样器 / Stochastic Path Sampler

entry.content:
从只有作用量、没有训练样本的采样问题出发，介绍 SPS 的正反路径、训练目标、路径权重和 Metropolis 修正。正文包含论文原图和两个交互演示。

阅读全文与交互图

Starting from an action and no training samples, this post introduces SPS through its forward and backward paths, training objective, path weights, and Metropolis correction. It includes figures from the paper and two interactive demos.
